title: Best free ai platforms?
author: Robbo2000000
selftext: Hi, i wanted to know if anyone got any suggestion on this. At the start of this year i started using base44 to create a bunch of stuff. I created a team builder for a pokemon game, then nothing until august. Then i started creating games of all kinds (for me, my brother and my friends), with a few being actually decent (for my standards). But the issue is that with the base plan of base44 i think i've done the best i could. I've trued to use emergent too, but without any success. Now i'm using a bit claude, but mainly for an editor regarding a racing sim. I would prefer if the suggestion was about a free platform, but if it offers something really good, i dont mind spending a few euros. I'm also not too much of an expert on how the technologies in this sector work, so don't go too harsh. Thx in advance

comments.author: Gigaslavx
comments.body: honestly if you're tight just get claude for coding and blast haiku. 20 bucks can last you a week of heavy coding. as for planning id go chatgpt even post nerf instant is very good value not sure how it will work post merge but if go gets you infinite instant its great value

replies.author: Robbo2000000
replies.body: Thx for the advice. An issue i have is that i habe 0 idea of how to create and manage 3d stuff. On base44 it all sucked on the graphic side

replies.author: CuriosityBoie
replies.body:
You can do Opus medium to high with sonnet subagents if your setup is at least half decent, and your prompts aren't "make an fps game", all for 20$ a month.   
Nothing is comparable at the price range tbh. It has worked me wonders before committing to the 100$ sub. Opencode GO for 10$ is also worth it, but much better in tandem with Claude

replies.author: Gigaslavx
replies.body:
I tried but it just didn't work out for me. Currently I orchestrate Haiku only and it works for about 18 hours per day with ChatGPT planning. I'd get a 2nd Pro but no point now there is Sonnet Medium but quality similar to Haiku High but it costs like 3.5 times as much, only benefit is speed but it means I run out very quick :)

Haiku does x amount of work in 100-125 hours on 1 Pro

Sonnet would do about 0.3x in 10-12.5 on 1 Pro and 0.6x in 25 hours on 2 - I'd do less for more money just in less time :)

replies.author: CuriosityBoie
replies.body: I guess it depends on what you’re building - for me the frontier quality took priority over anything else, and although I was hitting limits, 8-10 hours a day were no problem. What are you building that requires 18h/d ? Sounds insane haha

replies.author: Gigaslavx
replies.body:
Oh yeah of course I respect that

For me it's just a hobby project, it works autonomous for most part it's just slow hence the long hours :) I just did the maths if I speed it up I get more done but it will require paying 5 times as much, content with current pace after switching from Codex xd

replies.body:
https://i.redd.it/b3srqlraj74i1.png

I started using it almost two weeks ago and have been working on a bunch of projects that I otherwise wouldnt have gotten to.
